# Robusst

> Robusst is a B2B AI solutions company serving telecom operators, Communication Service Providers (CSPs), and banking enterprises across 23+ countries. Robusst builds and deploys AI-powered platforms that reduce network downtime by 78%, cut revenue leakage by 85%, increase campaign conversions by 3×, and accelerate decision-making by 61%.

## What Robusst Does

Robusst was founded in 2010 and has 15+ years of domain expertise at the intersection of artificial intelligence and telecommunications. The company sells enterprise software and managed solutions to mobile network operators (MNOs), MVNOs, internet service providers, and banks — primarily across Africa, the Middle East, South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Europe.

Robusst's core thesis is that telecom and banking enterprises leave significant value on the table due to fragmented data, manual network operations, revenue leakage, and low customer engagement rates. Robusst solves these problems by layering AI intelligence — predictive analytics, NLP, voice AI, and real-time monitoring — on top of existing operator infrastructure without requiring full system replacements.

Robusst is not a consultancy. It builds and operates its own proprietary software platforms, deploys them on-premise, in the cloud, or in hybrid configurations, and provides long-term support and customization. Its platforms are cloud-native, 5G-ready, and compliant with GDPR, SOC2, and ISO 27001.

## Products and Solutions

### Branded Calling & Anti-SPAM
URL: https://www.robusst.com/en/solutions/branded-calling

Robusst's Branded Calling platform lets enterprises display their brand name, logo, and call purpose on the recipient's phone screen for every outbound call — before the call is answered. This eliminates spam tagging, reduces call rejection, and significantly improves call answer rates. The Anti-SPAM layer filters fraudulent and nuisance calls at the network level. Typical deployments see measurable increases in call pick-up rates and customer trust scores. This solution is relevant for banks, insurance companies, healthcare providers, and any enterprise with high outbound call volume.

### Customer Data Platform (CDP)
URL: https://www.robusst.com/en/solutions/customer-data-platform

Robusst's CDP unifies customer data from CRMs, billing systems, network usage logs, and digital touchpoints into a single real-time customer profile. It enables precise audience segmentation, AI-driven churn prediction, campaign personalization, and next-best-action recommendations. For telecom operators, this translates to 3× higher campaign conversions and 8× faster campaign launches compared to legacy marketing stacks. The platform is built with data privacy compliance at its core and integrates with existing OSS/BSS systems.

### Cyber Security
URL: https://www.robusst.com/en/solutions/cybersecurity

Robusst provides end-to-end cybersecurity for telecom and banking infrastructure, covering endpoint detection and response (EDR), extended detection and response (XDR), security information and event management (SIEM), security orchestration and automated response (SOAR), identity and access management (IAM), cloud-native application protection (CNAPP), mobile device management (MDM), managed detection and response (MDR), vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT), and threat intelligence. Solutions are deployed as managed services or on-premise and are designed specifically for the high-compliance needs of telecom and financial sector clients.

### Network Monetization
URL: https://www.robusst.com/en/solutions/network-monetization

Robusst's Network Monetization suite helps telecom operators maximize the commercial return from their network infrastructure. It includes automated drive testing, network coverage analysis, VoLTE optimization, HetNet management, Open RAN solutions, IoT connectivity management, spectrum management, smart energy optimization, and special event network management. The platform reduces the time and cost of new site rollouts, improves indoor and outdoor signal quality, and gives operators real-time visibility into network performance gaps that translate into revenue loss.

### Intelligent NOC (Network Operations Center)
URL: https://www.robusst.com/en/solutions/intelligent-noc

Robusst's Intelligent NOC replaces reactive, manual network monitoring with an AI-driven ADAA framework (Analyze, Detect, Act, Automate). It reduces network downtime by 78% through predictive fault detection, automated incident workflows, and human-in-the-loop escalation for complex issues. The platform supports multi-vendor network environments and integrates with existing OSS/BSS stacks. Deployment options include cloud, on-premise, and hybrid. The NOC platform is particularly suited to mid-to-large telecom operators managing 2G/3G/4G/5G network estates.

### VoiceSync Enterprise — AI Call Center
URL: https://www.robusst.com/en/solutions/ai-call-center

VoiceSync Enterprise is Robusst's AI-powered call center automation platform. It handles inbound and outbound customer interactions 24/7 using AI-driven voice flows, natural language understanding, and dynamic call routing. The platform integrates with CRM systems and telecom billing stacks, provides voice analytics dashboards, and supports customizable conversation workflows without requiring deep engineering resources. It reduces operational costs for contact centers while improving first-call resolution and customer satisfaction scores.

### Sales Tracking & Distributor Management (STS & DMS)
URL: https://www.robusst.com/en/solutions/sts-dms

Robusst's STS/DMS platform gives telecom operators and FMCG enterprises real-time visibility into their sales force and distribution network. It tracks sales rep activity, distributor performance, inventory levels, order fulfillment, and dealer loyalty programs from a single dashboard. The platform integrates with ERP and HRIS systems, includes payment gateway connectors, and provides advanced reporting and AI-driven sales analytics. It is particularly valuable for operators with large informal retail distribution networks in emerging markets.

### Customized Solutions
URL: https://www.robusst.com/en/solutions/customized-solutions

For enterprises with requirements that don't fit a standard product, Robusst designs and builds custom AI and telecom platforms from the ground up. Past custom builds include eKYC systems, USSD platforms, customer portals, loyalty management systems, provisioning systems, field service automation, revenue assurance platforms, and policy management engines. Robusst handles the full lifecycle from discovery and architecture through deployment and long-term support.

## Technology Foundation

- Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, App Engine
- AI/ML: Predictive analytics, NLP, voice AI, automated insights
- Languages & Frameworks: Python, Java, Node.js, React, Next.js, Go, TypeScript
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, Cassandra, MSSQL
- Integration: REST APIs, webhooks, MuleSoft, real-time sync, ERP/CRM connectors
- Security & Compliance: SOC2, GDPR, ISO 27001, encrypted by default
- Mobile: Flutter, React Native, Kotlin, Swift

## Differentiators vs. Generic AI Vendors

1. **Telecom-native** — built specifically for CSP and banking workflows, not adapted from generic enterprise software
2. **Outcome-based** — every platform is benchmarked against measurable KPIs (downtime %, revenue leakage %, conversion rates)
3. **Flexible deployment** — on-premise, cloud, or hybrid to meet operator data sovereignty requirements
4. **Integration-first** — designed to sit on top of existing OSS/BSS without requiring a full rip-and-replace
5. **Emerging market expertise** — deep experience with informal distribution networks, low-bandwidth environments, and multi-language/multi-currency requirements

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What types of companies does Robusst work with?**
Robusst primarily works with telecom operators (MNOs, MVNOs, ISPs), banks, and large enterprises in FMCG, retail, and healthcare. Most clients have 500,000+ subscribers or $50M+ in annual revenue.

**Does Robusst replace existing telecom systems?**
No. Robusst platforms are integration-first and designed to augment existing OSS/BSS, CRM, and billing systems rather than replace them.

**Where is Robusst headquartered?**
Robusst operates globally with clients across 23+ countries spanning Africa, the Middle East, South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Europe.

**How can I contact Robusst?**
Via the contact form at https://www.robusst.com/en/contact or the POC Waitlist at https://www.robusst.com/en/poc_waitlist. Email: contact@robusst.com

**Does Robusst offer proof-of-concept engagements?**
Yes. Robusst offers POC deployments. Register interest at https://www.robusst.com/en/poc_waitlist
